explication: Mem Reduct is a Windows desktop utility for monitoring memory use and reclaiming selected system memory. Users inspect usage in the main window or tray, then trigger cleanup manually or configure automatic cleanup based on usage and elapsed time. Cleanup targets include working sets, file caches, standby and modified lists, and newer Windows memory regions. A single substantial C source file contains the sampled application logic, so the graph separates its user interface, monitoring, cleanup, and settings responsibilities without implying separate modules. The README documents Native API cleanup; unsampled implementation details and framework wiring are omitted.
